info.name: Azure Repos Git Commits Refs API
Azure Repos List refs (branches and tags)

params.name: repositoryId
params.description: The ID or name of the repository

params.name: filter
params.description: Filter refs by name prefix (e.g., heads/main, tags/v1)

params.name: includeLinks
params.description: Include reference links in the response

params.name: includeStatuses
params.description: Include status information for each ref

params.name: includeMyBranches
params.description: Include only branches owned by the authenticated user

params.name: peelTags
params.description: Annotated tags will populate the PeeledObjectId property

params.name: $top
params.description: Maximum number of refs to return

params.name: continuationToken
params.description: Continuation token for paging through results

items.docs: Retrieve all refs (branches and tags) for a repository. Supports filtering by name prefix, peeling tags to their target objects, and including statuses such as build and policy check results.

info.name: Azure Repos Create, update, or delete refs

params.name: repositoryId
params.description: The ID or name of the repository

items.docs: Create, update, or delete one or more refs (branches or tags) in a single atomic operation. To create a ref, set oldObjectId to 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000. To delete a ref, set newObjectId to 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000.
